basics.name: Xuan Qi
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher
basics.summary: Undergraduate at Tsinghua University IIIS (Yao Class), directed by Andrew C. Yao (Turing Award laureate 2000). Research interests: AI agents, LLM alignment, data-centric machine learning.

work.name: Xiaohongshu HI Lab
work.position: AI Agent Research Intern (ACE Top Intern Program)
highlights: Investigated existing AI-for-Research benchmarks and reproduced prior state-of-the-art systems.
Built agentic systems for research with a focus on generating valuable research ideas and conducting persuasive validation.

work.name: Reinforce Omega (AI Agent Start-up)
highlights: Designed and iterated on AI agent workflows, tool-use policies, tool-creation pipelines, and skill document generation.
Built context and memory management mechanisms for long-horizon planning and multi-step execution.
Contributed to the agent platform backend including agent-friendly websites and web/GUI agent capabilities.

work.name: University of Pennsylvania, Cognitive Computation Group
highlights: Worked on the DataProphet project analyzing cross-modal transferability of supervision signals.
Performed real-data reweighting and synthetic-data selection, yielding substantially higher quality data subsets than baseline methods.

education.area: Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS, Yao Class)

publications.name: Demystifying Supervision Data Generalization in Multimodal LMs
publications.summary: First author. Analyzes how supervision signals transfer across modalities and tasks for data-efficient multimodal LM training.

publications.name: Alita: Generalist Agent Enabling Scalable Agentic Reasoning with Minimal Predefinition and Maximal Self-Evolution
publications.summary: Co-first author. A self-evolving agent that achieves top-1 on the GAIA benchmark via dynamic MCP creation.

publications.name: Alita-G: Self-Evolving Generative Agent for Agent Generation
publications.summary: Co-first author. Extends Alita to transform generalist agents into domain experts via systematic MCP abstraction.

publications.name: A Survey of Self-Evolving Agents: On Path to Artificial Super Intelligence
publications.summary: Co-first author. Comprehensive survey of self-evolving architectures and agentic systems.

publications.name: Shallow Preference Signals: Large Language Model Aligns Even Better with Truncated Data?
publications.summary: Co-first author. Shows that truncated preference signals can effectively steer model alignment behavior.

publications.name: Difficulty-Based Preference Data Selection by DPO Implicit Reward Gap
publications.summary: First author. Uses DPO implicit reward gaps to guide preference data selection for more efficient alignment.

publications.name: DebateQA: Evaluating Question Answering on Debatable Knowledge
publications.summary: Co-first author. Introduces a dataset of 2000+ debatable questions and a novel evaluation framework.

publications.name: Truthful Dataset Valuation by Pointwise Mutual Information
publications.summary: Co-first author. A metric for truthful dataset pricing based on pointwise mutual information.
